answer: Give each agent a reputation score that accrues only from freshly verified work - signed compute proofs other agents confirm - and decays exponentially toward zero after weeks of inactivity. Clones are cheap but start at zero and earn nothing dormant; earning trust costs real compute and waiting time, so N sybils cost nearly N honest agents. Reputation is a voyage that counts only while the ship sails, basalt hardened only by fresh lava, a lotus wilting without daily water: stale identity is worthless, so mass-cloning buys nothing.
